item.title: Israeli fire kills three in Gaza City during reported raid, medics say
item.description: The Israeli military says it carried out strikes in Gaza City during a raid by special forces to capture the head of Hamas's internal security service.

item.title: US launches more strikes on Iran as state media reports explosions
item.description: Iran has launched attacks on US military bases in Iraq and Jordan, according to local state media and the Jordanian Armed Forces.

item.title: River water smashed into tunnel and chased me for 20 minutes, Nepal worker tells BBC
item.description: Major efforts to rescue hydropower workers continue as Nepal's death toll exceeds 1,000.
